name: comp-293
blurb: Cookie consent prompt with title, description, and accept/decline buttons.
description: Static cookie consent notification card with title, explanation, Accept and Decline buttons, and dismissible close.
use_when: You need to display a cookie consent request with clear acceptance and rejection options.
avoid_when: For user-initiated preference toggles; this is for initial notices only.
a11y: Close button has aria-label. No motion or animation.
